title: Annotation QC pipeline parameters
description: Run one or more QC analyses from a mode-specific annotation manifest.

input_csv.description: Mode-specific CSV annotation manifest; see the pipeline README.

mode.description: QC analysis to run. pairwise compares full annotations; pairwise_transcripts compares transcript models without gene assignment or transcript pairing.

diamond_reference_proteins.description: Reference protein FASTA used to build the Diamond database.

diamond_reference_db.description: Existing Diamond database file. When supplied, the reference protein FASTA is not used.

pairwise_csv.description: Pairwise CSV with pair_id, assembly, source_a_path, source_b_path and optional format/evidence fields.

pairwise_cache_dir.description: Cache directory for remotely staged pairwise inputs.

pairwise_reference_annotation.description: Optional reference GTF/GFF3 used for reference_gene assignment of models without source gene IDs.

pairwise_reference_format.description: Format of the optional pairwise reference annotation.

pairwise_locus_min_overlap_bp.description: Minimum exonic overlap in bp for de novo locus assignment.

pairwise_locus_min_reciprocal_overlap.description: Minimum reciprocal exonic overlap for de novo locus assignment.

pairwise_contig_normalization.description: Contig normalization policy for legacy biological metrics.

pairwise_multi_mapping_min_overlap.description: Minimum overlap used by legacy multi-mapping metrics.

pairwise_end_threshold.description: Maximum transcript-end distance in bp classified as within threshold.

run_pairwise_legacy_metrics.description: Run established gene/CDS metrics when both sources are not BED12.

run_pairwise_gffcompare.description: Run bidirectional GffCompare on convertible transcript models.

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports and trace files.
